title: Agent Assessment Values Source File
description: Shape of the human-authored SOURCE file docs/ai/agent-scores.yaml (D3a). This is the upstream source from which the renderer (D3b) projects the rendered agent_assessment frontmatter block validated by agent-assessment.schema.json. This source file is keyed by CANONICAL agent TEMPLATE key (e.g. 'architect'), never by a generated display name. It carries categorical values only (risk_level, decision) plus a source-only 'rationale' that MUST NOT be rendered to frontmatter. Numeric rubric fields (score, confidence, role_clarity, ...) are NOT permitted in D3a; they are gated to a separate human-approved numeric pass (D3c). This schema documents the contract; tools/ai/validate-agent-assessment-values.php enforces it (no YAML extension is required at runtime, matching validate-script-access.php).

approved.description: Human approval gate. While false, the values are DRAFT review input and renderers (D3b) MUST NOT consume the file. Flip to true only after a human approves the categorical values.

agents.description: Map of canonical agent TEMPLATE key -> assessment entry. Every live agent template must have exactly one entry; no stale entries are allowed.

agent_assessment.description: Categorical-only assessment. Numeric fields are intentionally disallowed in v1 (D3a). The renderer copies ONLY the fields that agent-assessment.schema.json accepts.

risk_level.description: Sourced from the existing docs/ai/AGENTS-MANIFEST.md Risk classification (identity mapping, same vocabulary). Not invented.

rationale.description: Human-approved reason for the assessment. SOURCE-ONLY: must never be rendered into agent frontmatter.
